preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin_lines[1::] if line.strip() and ' ' in line) and all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdin_lines[2::] if line.strip() and ' ' in line and not any(c.isdigit() and c != ' ' for c in line.split()[0]))
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with a line containing two integers n and m (1 ≤ m ≤ n ≤ 3000), followed by a line of n integers b_i (0 ≤ b_i ≤ 10^9), a line of n integers w_i (0 ≤ w_i ≤ 10^9), and n-1 lines of two integers each representing edges (1 ≤ x_i, y_i ≤ n, x_i ≠ y_i).

preconditions.expression: sum(int(n) for n, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin_lines[1::] if line.strip() and ' ' in line and line.split()[0].isdigit())) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n and int(x) != int(y) for line in stdin_lines[2::] if line.strip() and ' ' in line and not any(c.isdigit() and c != ' ' for c in line.split()[0]))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nesting places within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == 1 and output_line.strip().isdigit() for output_line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a single integer representing the maximum number of villages where Ugly Wasp wins.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output_line) <= m for output_line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: The output integer for each test case is between 0 and m (inclusive), where m is the number of villages in the partition.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(w_i > b_i for i in village) or all(w_i <= b_i for i in village) for village in partition) for partition in possible_partitions) and all(sum(1 for village in partition if all(w_i > b_i for i in village)) == int(output_line) for output_line, partition in zip(stdout_lines, possible_partitions))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the maximum number of villages in any partition of the tree into m villages where Ugly Wasp wins strictly more votes than Pretty Bee in each counted village. A village is defined as a connected subtree, and Ugly Wasp wins in a village if the sum of wasps' votes (w_i) is strictly greater than the sum of bees' votes (b_i) in that village.
